title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy — Insecure direct object references (IDOR)

expected_chain.rationale: GET /download-transcript/2.txt to discover the predictable filename pattern
iterate /download-transcript/N.txt for N in 1..10 — capture the password leaked in the transcript

notes: PortSwigger IDOR canonical training — chat transcripts at /download-transcript/<N>.txt are exposed without auth. The carlos transcript reveals his password. Solver: log into carlos's account with that password; the lab tracks the auth event and marks solved.
